selection_method: Reviewed owner/consumer paths and preserved existing test IDs; explicit human impact review, not import-based automatic coverage inference.

documentation.scope: Documentation, inventory and executable examples/import contracts.
documentation.limits: No production code/resource/dependency/build/collection changes. Archive and public-import checks still run normally on the Mac.

request-lifecycle.scope: Synchronous request ownership/rollback or optional journaling hooks; standalone configuration semantics, numerical models and export algorithms preserved.
request-lifecycle.limits: Review actual diff, including tests/fixtures. Not sufficient for changed astronomy, coordinate/time meaning, state admission, configuration behavior, renderer, atlas implementation, resource schema, shared dependencies/build/collection, threading, kernel routing or new consumers. No automatic permission to skip tests based on filenames.

request-configuration.limits: Add owning numerical/geometry/render tests if underlying algorithms or scientific contracts change. Not a universal chart gate or an independent installation claim; review public callers when APIs change.

acceptance: Named gates are proposed until normal Mac collection/execution passes. The 3415-test receipt establishes current baseline; no performance claim for new selections before timing.
